title: Musicians who smoked hop: Moe Shelson's pipe
summary: Love tells how his Shreveport band stole violinist Moe Shelson's clarinet-like opium pipe as a prank and how smoking darkened him.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Did many of the musicians smoke that stuff?
Oh, they had a lot of fellas that used to do that. Smoke opium? Smoke hop.
Yeah, smoke hop.

That's what I'm talking about. Yeah, some kind of stuff to fix up. Moe's Chelsea in Shreeport. Man, the Patterson, we caught up with him, you know, we know he's smoking something. So we had a job down in Mansfield, you see. We all had to get room to sleep that night. So Moe's got him a room by himself, you know, and he had a whole suitcase with him besides his Violet case, you know. Man, he said, we gonna have some fun tonight when we get off from that dam. We got off from the dance, you know, and Moe went in his room, put on some pink pajamas, went in there and while he was out in the back somewhere that man he went and looked in the suitcase and man, he had a pipe in there that looked like a clarinet. You know, the one Piku played, go down and come back up and well, that's why he put that stuff in there, you know. He hold that over there and he's smoking. Had holes on there too, you know, let stuff come out. Man, he said, look here, I didn't know Moe was a clarinet player. He said, this guy got a fucking little instrument of clarinet. And he said, let's steal it and see what he's gonna do and see how he's gonna act. So we stole that clarinet where he had that hot pipe, brought it in and hit it. Moe was coming in, you know, and he went to get his smoke. He looked in his suitcase, that pipe was gone. Boy, you oughta heard the talk. He put on there. He said, anybody got my pipe? He said, they take that, they ain't no man. He said, I'd kill him if I know who took him. Nobody answered the word, you know, because two, three of them fellas stole that pipe, you see. they just went on and took what he said. Now he raised some sand. When he went out somewhere in town, they slipped it back in his grip, you know, and he come back. Now he raised sand again. He smoked that pipe so much till he come out, he was a black man, but he looked like a China.
Changed his color, huh?
Mm-hmm. He was real dark? He was a real dark fella, but he come after looking like a black China when he smoked so much.
He had slanty eyes and everything?
His eyes got that way. He kind of looked like a China when I know but he was a black fella. A violin player.
Did it change his color, really?
Mm-hmm.
Made him lighter?
Made him darker.
Oh, darker. Wait a minute, I'll turn it off.
Black China.
You say he had a pretty good band in three parts that far?
Yeah.
What was his name?
Moe Shelson.
Is he still alive, you think?
I don't know. Moe smoked so much of that stuff I guess he's about dead now. I never hear from him anymore.
